The statements chapter supplies the explicit choice among multiple eligible locals. The class and annotation discussion bounds applicability, including the restriction on rebinding type parameters. The reopened Python 3.13.0 statement reference identifies enclosing functions as the candidate scopes. When several supply a binding, the innermost eligible one wins. When none supplies one, the declaration produces SyntaxError. The companion execution-model passage establishes compile-time detection and explains which bindings are lexically visible. Together the passages support the claim for the specified ordinary functions.

limitations: The name `__class__` is excluded because Python’s Data model describes an implicit class closure reference.
An intervening function’s global declaration can make a farther function-local binding unavailable. Module globals and ordinary class attributes do not supply function-local bindings.
The lexical binding rule does not require the variable already to have a runtime value when the declaration is parsed.
